subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers adopt/refresh the open conflicting fork PR, or close it and replace it with a narrow repo-local fix for Copilot `auth.order` selection?
rationale: The bug is clear and narrow, but an open linked fork PR already owns the GitHub closing path and is currently conflicting, so automation should not create another fix lane until maintainers choose the candidate path.

options.title: Replace or adopt the linked fix
options.body: Review the open fork PR, then either refresh/adopt it or close it and land an equivalent narrow fix in the main repository.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts and provide updated proof.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the linked fix
recommendation.body: Review the open fork PR, then either refresh/adopt it or close it and land an equivalent narrow fix in the main repository.

likelyOwner.reason: This account merged the Copilot plugin work that introduced the current helper and is a strong adjacent routing candidate for deciding whether to adopt or replace the linked fix.
